name: Monologue
source:
32 stories with 32 heroines. The secrets of girls that can not be spoken out loud are revealed here. Can such cute heroines really have such big secrets?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
32個故事，32位女主角。那些無法大聲說出口的女孩們的秘密在此揭曉。這麼可愛的女主角們，真的會有這麼大的秘密嗎？
